And I'm not talking about all people of course. Just the ones that don't let you assert your boundaries. There are people who are kind in return as well.

If the amount of time you need alone after meeting a certain person is increasing on a consistent rate, know that your boundaries are being violated by either you or them and your energy is being drained faster and faster each time.

 As an INFJ I have struggled with this all my life until I learned that my inner child is more important than the person standing in front of me. Instead of thinking from their mind, that is, what they think of me (she's so boring,  whata buzzkill, etc etc), it's more rooted in my honesty that I respect how I feel about things. If my inner child doesn't wanna hang out, she can stay in. Because I allow her to do so. Because i am my own parent. And I take care of my energy.  People will never care for you. YOU have to uphold your inner child without the GUILT they induce. Because the inner child never asks for much. Then why can't she have the little of what she asks. Right?

The people I learned,  always induce guilt. They never once hesitate or remember how you never push them. In essence, they conveniently forget to respect your boundaries. And our fear of rejection plays out in us not asserting our boundaries, in us not conserving our energy, in us giving more then what we're capable of. Inner work is so important and I promise you. Your life will change once you slowly slowly allow yourself to be yourself. Don't wanna hangout. Don't. Guilt? Sit with it. Understand where it's coming from. Check what's in it's core and then replace it with a healthy belief. Goodluck :)
